translations.text: In the second year of King Darius, in the sixth month, on the first day of the month, the word of the Lord came by the hand of Haggai the prophet, and he said: Say to Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, of the tribe of Judah, and to Joshua son of Jozadak, the high priest, and he said:
Thus says the Lord Almighty, and he said: This people says, "The time has not yet come to build the house of the Lord."
And the word of the Lord came by the hand of Haggai the prophet, and he said:
If it is your time to live in paneled houses, but [?] — set your hearts on your ways.

You sowed much and brought in little; you ate, but not to satisfaction; you drank, but not to drunkenness; you clothed yourselves, but could not get warm; and he who gathered wages gathered them into a bag with holes.
Thus says the Lord Almighty: Set your hearts on your ways.
Go up to the mountain and cut timber, and build my house, and I will take pleasure in it, and I will be glorified, says the Lord.

And you looked for much, and it came to little; and you brought it into your houses, and I blew it away from there. Therefore thus says the Lord Almighty: Because my house is desolate, while you go each one into his own house.
Therefore the heaven will hold back the dew, and the earth will withhold its produce.

And I will call down a sword upon the land and upon the mountains, and upon the wheat and the wine and the oil, and whatever the earth brings forth, and upon men and upon cattle, and upon all the labor of their hands.

And Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, of the tribe of Judah, and Joshua son of Jozadak, the high priest, and all the remnant of the people heard the voice of the Lord their God and these words of Haggai the prophet, because the Lord their God had sent him to them; and the people were afraid before the face of the Lord.
And Haggai, the messenger of the Lord among the messengers of the Lord, said to the people: I am with you, says the Lord.

And the Lord stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, of the tribe of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua son of Jozadak, the high priest, and the spirit of all the remnant of the people; and they went in and worked on the house of the Lord Almighty, their God.
On the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month, in the second year of King Darius. In the seventh month, on the twenty-first day of the month, the Lord spoke by the hand of Haggai the prophet, and said:
Say to Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, of the tribe of Judah, and to Joshua son of Jozadak, the high priest, and to all the remnant of the people, and say:
Who among you saw this house in its former glory? And how do you see it now — as if it were nothing before you?

And now be strong, Zerubbabel, says the Lord; and be strong, Joshua son of Jozadak, you high priest; and let all the people of the land be strong, says the Lord, and work, for I am with you, says the Lord Almighty.
This is the word that I promised you when you came out of Egypt, and my spirit remains among you. Do not be afraid,
for thus says the Lord Almighty: Once more I will shake the heaven and the earth, the sea and the dry land.
And I will shake all the nations, and the chosen of all peoples will come, and I will fill this house with glory, says the Lord Almighty.
Mine is the silver, and mine is the gold, says the Lord Almighty.

For the glory of this latter house will be great, greater than that of the first, says the Lord Almighty. And in this place I will give peace, says the Lord Almighty, and peace of soul as a help to all who build to raise up this temple.
On the twenty-fourth of the ninth month, in the second year of King Darius, the word of the Lord came to Haggai the prophet, and he said:
Thus says the Lord Almighty: Ask the priests about the law, and say to them:

If a man carries holy meat in the fold of his garment, and the edge of his garment touches bread, or stew, or wine, or oil, or any food at all, will it become holy? And the priests answered and said, No.
And Haggai said: If someone who has been defiled by a soul touches any of these, will it become defiled? And the priests answered and said, It will become defiled.

Haggai answered and said to them: So is this people, and so is this nation before me, says the Lord. So also are the works of their hands, and whatever touches them will be defiled, because of their early-morning words. They will be in pain before the face of their wickedness, and you hated the one who rebuked you at the gates.
And now set it in your hearts, from this day onward, before stone was laid upon stone in the temple of the Lord.
What were you when you put twenty measures in the storehouse and it became ten measures of barley, and you went down to the winepress to draw off fifty measures and it came to twenty?
I struck you with barrenness and with blight and with hail in all the work of your hands, and you did not turn to me, says the Lord.
Now set your hearts from this day and onward, from the twenty-fourth of the ninth month, and from this day on which the temple of the Lord was founded; set it in your hearts,
whether it will yet be seen on the threshing floor, and in the vine and the fig tree and the pomegranate and the olive tree, which did not bear fruit. From this day on I will bless you.
And the word of the Lord came to Haggai the prophet a second time, on the twenty-fourth of the month, and he said:
Say to Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, of the tribe of Judah: I will shake heaven and earth, the sea and the dry land;

and I will overturn the thrones of kings, and destroy the power of the kings of all the nations. I will overthrow chariots and riders, and horses and riders will fall, and those mounted on them, each man by the sword of his brother.

On that day, says the Lord Almighty, I will bring you, Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, my servant, says the Lord, and I will set you like a signet ring, for I have found you pleasing, says the Lord Almighty.
